title: L1->L2 reseed never initializes global Silo total stalk/roots (s.sys.silo.stalk / s.sys.silo.roots), breaking the protocol-wide stalk-conservation invariant and corrupting roots/earned-Bean accounting for the entire migrated population

related: beanstalk/init/InitReseed.sol (init: sets paused/season/flags, no global stalk/roots)

description: Stalk and roots are governance weight and earned-Bean share. The protocol-wide invariant is that the global totals s.sys.silo.stalk and s.sys.silo.roots equal the sum of all per-account s.accts[].stalk / .roots; Invariable.noNetFlow/noOutFlow even enforce 'global stalk does not decrease' against s.sys.silo.stalk as a safety net. During the L1->L2 reseed, ReseedSilo.reseedSiloDeposit issues per-account stalk (s.accts[account].stalk = accountStalk) and per-token global balances, but NEVER writes the global aggregates s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots. Tracing the entire beanstalk/init/ tree (InitReseed.init, ReseedSilo, ReseedSun, ReseedWhitelist, ReseedField, ReseedBarn, ReseedInternalBalances) confirms there is no write to s.sys.silo.stalk or s.sys.silo.roots anywhere in the reseed/init sequence (grep over beanstalk/init/ returns only the per-account s.accts[].stalk assignment). DT-009 raised this symptom as Medium 'pending a trace of where total stalk is set'; that trace is now complete and the global totals are confirmed to remain zero after migration. Consequences span subsystems: (1) Roots minting breaks — LibSilo.mintActiveStalk and LibGerminate take the `s.sys.silo.roots == 0` branch and mint roots = stalk * ROOTS_BASE as if the first post-migration actor were the genesis depositor, while every reseeded account holds stalk but ZERO roots; since roots (not stalk) determine earned-Bean distribution, the entire migrated population earns near-zero yield and the first mower/depositor captures a grossly disproportionate root share. (2) Global stalk is understated to 0 while Sigma(accts.stalk) is large, violating stalk conservation; LibGauge (s.sys.silo.stalk.div(totalBdv)) computes wrong gauge output, and the Invariable noNetFlow/noOutFlow baseline is wrong from genesis. (3) LibReceiving sunrise earned-Bean shipping increments global stalk by minted Beans only, so the desync between account stalk and global stalk/roots is permanent. This is a protocol-level, cross-subsystem (Silo + Sun + migration-completeness) invariant break not owned by any single specialist's per-account finding.
impact: Permanent post-migration corruption of the global Silo stalk/roots accounting for the whole protocol: reseeded depositors hold stalk with zero roots and therefore earn near-zero share of all future earned-Bean (sunrise) distributions, while the first post-migration actor mints genesis-scale roots and captures a disproportionate yield/voting share; governance quorum (vote weight aggregate) and LibGauge output are mis-scaled; the Invariable stalk-conservation safety net operates against a wrong baseline. Affects every migrated holder with no attacker required (self-triggers on the reseed), with an additional opportunistic economic upside for the first mower.

ite.intent: After the L1->L2 reseed the global Silo total stalk and roots must equal the sum of all reseeded per-account stalk/roots, so earned-Bean distribution, governance weight, gauge math, and the Invariable safety net all operate on a consistent base.
ite.technique: The reseed writes only per-account stalk (and per-token deposited balances) and omits initializing the global aggregates s.sys.silo.stalk and s.sys.silo.roots; downstream roots minting branches on roots==0 and divides by silo.stalk.
ite.evasion: No attacker is needed to trigger the corruption (it self-triggers on the migration upgrade); an opportunistic first-mover can additionally capture genesis-scale roots before others mow.

ice_chain.corrupted_state: s.sys.silo.stalk == 0 and s.sys.silo.roots == 0 after reseed, while Sigma(s.accts[].stalk) > 0 (conservation invariant broken)
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibSilo.mintActiveStalk / LibGerminate (roots minting), earned-Bean distribution by roots, LibGauge, Invariable.noNetFlow/noOutFlow
ice_chain.impact: Reseeded population earns ~0 earned-Bean and holds 0 roots; first post-migration actor mints disproportionate genesis-scale roots; gauge/governance/safety-net all mis-scaled
ice_chain.exploit_path: diamondCut runs Reseed* init set -> per-account stalk seeded, global silo.stalk/roots left 0 -> first mow -> mintActiveStalk roots==0 branch mints stalk*ROOTS_BASE to caller -> subsequent earned-Bean shipments distribute by roots, starving reseeded holders
